clauses.clause: Checkpoint: ≥ 3 police vehicles with light bars, ≥ 4 officers firing visibly, ≥ 8 civilians; gate closes ≤ 1.5 s after the player crosses; no infected crosses after.
clauses.note: All22 fresh frames personally inspected. Wide checkpoint frame shows3 police vehicles with red/blue light bars;4 officers visibly aim/fire muzzle flashes, confirmed4 actual shot-source IDs. Actual nonhidden/noninfected civilians within12m of checkpoint centre: low9/high8, including market arrivals (low prepared135 absent, not silently counted). Native gate closure0.6s; postclosure crossingIDs empty at both qualities;2/5 infected were already inside at closure and are not later crossings. No all-eight unoccluded-pixel claim from cropped tight frame.
